definitions.explanation: The area around the hips, or its measurement, used for clothing sizes and body shape.

examples.japanese: {腰回|こしまわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧。
{腰回|こしまわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}って→測る：01977_hakaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{太|ふと}って→太る：01190_futoru⟧、{腰回|こしまわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きつく→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I've put on weight lately, and my trousers have got tight around the hips.

notes:
Used for clothes, measurements and body shape. In sizes, {腰回|こしまわ}り corresponds to the hip measurement; the waist is ウエスト or {胴回|どうまわ}り.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腰回|こしまわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧: tight around the hips
- {腰回|こしまわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: flesh around the hips
- {腰回|こしまわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure the hips

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ヒップ→ヒップ：29031_hippu⟧: hips, hip size (loanword, common in clothing sizes)
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧: lower back, hips — the body part itself
